summary: Fidelity Private Credit Fund filed an 8-K reporting routine monthly distributions, supplemental distributions, NAV, and a performance update. The filing declares gross and net distributions per share for Classes I, S, and D, payable September 30, 2026, and provides NAV as of July 31, 2026, with aggregate NAV of $1.4 billion and portfolio fair value of $2.5 billion. No special situation is present; this is a routine current report of operating results and financial condition.
